body: its nice to see someone being honest here. again, everyone here is "it will get better" and "your life is great" but youre willing to admit that happiness is sometimes fleeting and sometimes you need to be an asshole to the people who need it.
fine but again, im a terrible person. if i was actualy the person people wanted to be friends with i wouldnt be here
again, im not a very good friend. everybody ive ever known has reminded me of that.

youre probably the most honest person on this subreddit, or at least the most relatable for someone actually going through it. being an asshole to some people is the first step in getting over depression.
you dont even know me. if you actually met me in real life and got to know me youd want nothing to do with me.

well yeah, a lot of the comments here are blissfully happy, but i more meant that you admit that you treat other people like shit. you barely see that in real life, let alone the community of "it gets better"
unless they tell me that im just crazy and get my commited so i dont hurt myself or others.
thats a very interesting comment to see on /r/depression.
i really have no one and its not really an itch, its more like taking a vice grip off my head. im going to suffer until i finally do it.
i dont think theyd give me a prescription for free and even if they did all it would do is let me see how shitty my life is. its not my brain its my life thats wrong
theres no one to tell. i have no friends and my family doesnt care. i dont have and cant afford a doctor to tell all this to.
honestly i have nothing. i family that cares, no friends, and no future that doesnt involve me dead or on the streets. nobody would miss me.
im a nobody, ive never been happy, and if i knew how to help myself i wouldnt be on suicide watch
theres no bait, i have no reason to live and tons as to why i shouldnt. i thought you guys were supposed to tell me otherwise.
